test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

Had I known about the delay, I **will wait.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the conditional form, specifically the third conditional, which is used to describe situations that did not happen in the past.
 
• The structure of the third conditional is: **If + past perfect, would have + past participle**.
 
• In this case, "Had I known about the delay" is the past perfect clause, so the correct continuation is "I would have waited."
 
• The original sentence uses "will wait," which is incorrect because it does not align with the third conditional structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Had I known about the delay, I **would have waited.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "will have waited" is incorrect because it suggests a future perfect tense, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** "would waited" is grammatically incorrect because "would" must be followed by the base form "have" and the past participle "waited."
 
• **Option 4:** "waited" alone is incorrect because it does not include the modal verb "would" or "would have," which are required in the third conditional.
